name: Extremal-Extension VC Dimension
definition: For a finite class $\mathcal H$, the **extremal-extension VC dimension** $\mathrm{VC}_{\mathrm{extr}}(\mathcal H)$ is the least $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal E)$ among extremal (shattering-extremal) classes $\mathcal E$ on the same domain with $\mathcal H\subseteq\mathcal E$. Here extremal means that the number of shattered sets equals $|\mathcal E|$.
graph_summary: Least VC dimension of an extremal class containing the given finite class.
description: Measures the VC cost of embedding a class into a shattering-extremal class.

monotonic.proof: Every extremal extension of a containing class is also an extremal extension of its subfamily.

p_monotonic.proof: A projection of an extremal class is extremal and cannot have larger VC dimension; projecting an extremal extension gives one for the projection.

doubly_monotonic.proof: The preceding extension and projection arguments establish both monotonicities.

c_monotonic.proof: Conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection, so it follows from double monotonicity.
